source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: D214331 asks should-form descriptions so the same message works for success and failure. Historical/current tests state expected status-bar request counts rather than saying an event already succeeded. Proposed manual rule: name the object and expected result in assertion messages, often using should. This wording preference is beyond formatter/lint, not an enforced universal requirement.
title: Write assertions as expected-state statements that read on failure
